title: Adding/wiring a service requires 3 coordinated edits (wire DI)
answers: What do I need to change when adding a new service?
Why does my new service constructor not get injected?
How does wire dependency injection work in grafana backend?
body: Provider sets live in `pkg/server/wire_core.go` (build-tag-gated `wire.go` only has top-level `wire.Build` calls, not the sets themselves). One concrete struct commonly satisfies several narrow interfaces, each registered/bound separately, e.g. for dashboards (`wire_core.go:338-343`): `dashboardservice.ProvideDashboardServiceImpl`, `wire.Bind(new(dashboards.PermissionsRegistrationService), new(*dashboardservice.DashboardServiceImpl))`, `ProvideDashboardService`, `ProvideDashboardProvisioningService`, `ProvideDashboardPluginService`, `ProvideDashboardAccessService`. To add a service: (1) write its `ProvideX` constructor in the service package, (2) add it (plus any `wire.Bind` interface->impl mapping) to the matching `wire.NewSet` block in `wire_core.go`, (3) regenerate `pkg/server/wire_gen.go` via `make gen-go`. Skipping step 3 leaves wire_gen.go stale and the new provider unused at runtime.
applies: Applies to any backend service intended to be injected via the wire-based DI graph in pkg/server. Does not apply to services only used within a single package via manual construction/tests.
